Ambiguity.description: Why a lookup leads to more than one object.

AssumedCosmology.description:
The cosmology a published value assumed, as its source states it: the Hubble constant and,
where stated, the densities of matter and of Λ today. A length in h⁻¹ Mpc assumes
H0 = 100 km/s/Mpc. Checked when read; a value built in code is checked where it is used.

At.description: When a time record's time is: an instant, or a span before J2000.0.

oneOf.description:
An ISO 8601 instant in the record's timescale, proleptic Gregorian, such as
`1987-02-23T07:35:35Z` in UTC or `2017-08-17T12:42:09.184` in TT; a trailing `Z` is
allowed in UTC alone.

Julian years before J2000.0, on TT, for times before year 1 such as a distant source
event.

Bounds.description: A node's cube, in the unit.

CandidateLink.description:
A candidate match to another object: both stay separate objects, and no measurement is
merged across the link.

candidate.description: The entry of the other object.

entry.description: The entry of this object that the link starts from.

reason.description:
What made it a candidate: a match record, or a cross-identification that would have
joined two entries of one source.

Centre.description:
A point placed by the release: ICRS equatorial Cartesian about the Solar System barycentre,
in its scale domain's unit, under the release cosmology, at epoch [`STRUCTURE_EPOCH`].

epoch.description: The epoch of the position, a Julian year: always [`STRUCTURE_EPOCH`], J2000.0.

frame.description: "ICRS equatorial Cartesian", as the tile manifests name it.

unit.description:
The scale domain's unit ([`scale_domain_unit`]): `parsec` for stars, `megaparsec`
otherwise, named as a shape names its unit.

item.description: The item it concerns; absent for a change of the layer itself.

ChangeKind.description: What kind of change a layer's change is.

ChangePage.description: A page of a layer's changes after a cursor.

cursor.description:
The sequence number of the last change this page holds, to ask for what follows; the
cursor asked when it holds none.

ColourBands.description: The two bands a colour index lies between.

Confidence.description: A confidence in a match, between 0 and 1. Checked when built and when read.

Cosmology.description:
A flat ΛCDM cosmology without radiation, as a release names it. Checked when built and when
read.

omega_matter.description: The matter density today; Λ makes up the rest.

Coverage.description: Where a source's catalogue entries lie.

radial.description: The range of each radial measure its entries hold: redshift, distance or parallax.

oneOf.description: The sky its entries lie on; absent when none has a sky position.

CreateLayer.description: What a client asks to create.

Decided.description: What made the preferred measurement win.

Derivation.description:
How a structure's placed shape was derived from its published numbers:
`structure_details.derivation`.

at_least.description:
Where its papers give the shape as a lower limit on the structure's extent, such as
"at least 25° × 20°": a JSON pointer to that citation in the record. Absent when they do
not, so the structure is known to reach as far as its shape and no further.

cosmology.description: The cosmology it is placed under: always `release`.

oneOf.description:
For a structure placed at a point whose papers give its extent along each axis of a frame
but not where it ends: those extents about the point. Its bounds stay the point's.

frame_chain.description: Each move of frame, cited as an object's derivation cites it.

from.description:
JSON pointers (RFC 6901) to the cited values in the structure's record that the shape
comes from.

oneOf.description: For a structure placed as its admitted grid outline: the grid, the factor and the frame.

DerivedPositionRecord.description: The object's derived position under the release cosmology.

oneOf.description: The cosmology the native value was published for, where it depends on one.

chain.description: The transformations that produced it, in order, each with its citation.

cosmology.description: The release cosmology it was placed under.

direction_frame.description: The frame its direction was published in, by its preferred position's entry.

distance.description: Its radial distance, Mpc, with its uncertainty.

epoch.description: The epoch of its direction, its sky position's, a Julian year.

frame.description: "ICRS equatorial Cartesian", as the tile manifests name it.

measure.description: Which distance that is: comoving, or kept as published.

native.description:
The value it was derived from, as published: a distance's or parallax's native value,
or a redshift's CMB-frame value.

scale_domain.description: The scale domain it is tiled in: `stars`, `nearby_galaxies` or `cosmic_web`.

unit.description: The scale domain's unit: parsecs for stars, megaparsecs otherwise.

Designation.description:
A source's own name for an entry: the source and its identifier, such as Gaia DR3 and a
`source_id`.

DipoleModel.description:
A measurement of the Sun's motion against the cosmic microwave background, named in each
redshift derived with it.

DistanceDerivation.description: Where a placed shape's distance comes from, and how it was found.

oneOf.description: The other form its source published beside the native value, kept and not used.
The cosmology the value was published for, where it depends on one.

measure.description: Which distance it is: luminosity, comoving, Euclidean or unspecified.

method.description: The indicator or technique behind it.

DistanceKind.description: How a distance was obtained, from the most direct to the most model-dependent.

Encoding.description: The tile encoding the manifest's tiles use.

colour_bands.description: The colour bands, coded by their index plus one, 0 coding none; absent before version 2.

kinds.description: The kind-of-value codes, in order from 0.

point_source.description: What a point's source index names.

steps_per_edge.description: The quantization steps along a node's edge: a step is the edge over this.

EncodingLayout.description: The byte layout of a tile of one version of the encoding.

colour_bands.description: The colour bands, coded by their index plus one, 0 coding none; none before version 2.

dequantization.description: How a quantized position becomes a position in the manifest's frame and unit.

header_bytes.description: The bytes before the first point: the header fields' bytes together.

kinds.description: The kinds of value, coded by their index.

point_bytes.description: The bytes each point takes: the point fields' bytes together.

steps_per_edge.description: The quantization steps along a node's edge.

tile_bytes.description: The size of a tile of `n` points.

EntryCounts.description: The catalogue entries of a source: fetched is published and left out together.

EntryPosition.description: An entry's sky position: as published, and in ICRS degrees.

epoch.description: Its epoch as published, a Julian year.

frame.description: The frame it was published in.

lon.description: Longitude and latitude as published, in `unit`.

ra.description:
Its ICRS right ascension and declination, degrees: at `epoch`, or at J2000 for a
position published in FK4 B1950 or with its equinox unstated.

uncertainty.description: Its errors as published, each beside its value in degrees, or none reported.

EntryRecord.description:
A catalogue entry of the object: the designation its source gives it, how it was resolved
into the object, and its sky position as published.

entry.description: Its number among the object's entries, from 0, as measurements name it.

flags.description: Its source's quality columns, by column name, as published.

group_id.description: The group its source assigns it to, by that source's group id.

name.description: A second name its source gives, such as a Hipparcos number.

oneOf.description: Its sky position as published; absent when its source publishes none.

resolved_by.description:
How it was resolved into the object: the anchor, a published cross-identification, or a
match with its method, separation, line-of-sight difference and confidence, each through
the entry it names.

oneOf.description:
Its spectral type, character for character as its source publishes it, with its kind
of value.

Extents.description:
A structure's published extents along the axes of the frame they were published in, about
its point, where its papers do not say where it ends. The point need not be its middle.

axes.description:
Each axis's whole extent as a vector in the ICRS, in the shape's unit, in the order of
the frame's axes: a line through the point runs half of it each way.

frame.description: The frame whose axes the extents were published along.

from.description: JSON pointers to the cited values each axis comes from, in the same order.

method.description: How each published extent became a length.

FieldType.description: The type of a field's elements, every number little-endian and unaligned.

Filters.description:
What narrows the results. Each filter given keeps only the results that carry one of the
values it names, so a result that carries none, such as a layer item under `kinds`, is left
out.

kinds.description: Kinds of object (terms such as `galaxy`) and of structure (such as `void`).

scale_domains.description: Scale domains, by name: their objects and structures.

sources.description: Sources of the release, by id: objects with an entry from one of them.

Fix.description: A fix of a known defect of a source.

entries_changed.description: How many entries it changed in this release.

reason.description: The defect: what is wrong in the source as published.

Fixed.description: The value a header field must hold.

FractionalUncertainty.description: The fractional distance uncertainty, the error over the distance, that a measurement was ranked by.

oneOf.description:
`total` is what was compared: the measurement's own term and, for a redshift distance,
the peculiar-velocity term, added in quadrature. A redshift published without an error
has no measurement term.

The source published no uncertainty the rule can compare, such as none at all or an
upper limit: the measurement ranks after every one with an uncertainty.

Geometry.description: The shape that places an object, structure or layer item. Meshes are not among them.

oneOf.description:
A line of sight from `origin` along the unit vector `direction`, out to `reach`, the edge
of the volume it is drawn in.
A unit `direction` whose distance is known only to lie between `near` and `far`.
A polyline through two or more points.
A region of the sky as `HEALPix` cells (a MOC), between two distances.
A grid of `shape` cells of edge `cell` from the corner `origin`, axis-aligned in its frame.

Some cells of a volume grid: a region of `grid` outlined on its cells, such as a void
where a density field falls below a threshold. The grid is laid out as for
[`Geometry::VolumeGrid`]; each cell is given by its indices along X, Y and Z of the frame.

index.description: Its number among the grid's fields, from 0: the path of its samples ends in it.

kind.description: Its kind of value, `reconstructed` for a reconstruction.

samples.description: The path of its samples in the same release.

uncertainty.description: The path of the samples of its uncertainty, where it was published with one.

GridList.description: The volume grids of a release.

GridPlacement.description:
How a grid outline becomes a placed shape: its cells kept in the grid's frame, its origin and
cell edge turned from the grid's unit into the shape's by one factor.

centre.description: How the structure's centre is found from the shape.

factor.description: The factor from the grid's unit to the shape's: 100 / H0 of the release for h⁻¹ Mpc.

frame.description: The grid's frame, which the shape keeps.

grid.description: The volume grid the outline was drawn on.

native_unit.description: The grid's unit, such as h⁻¹ Mpc.

GridSummary.description: One volume grid as listed; its header gives the rest.

fields.description: The quantities it samples, in the order of their samples files.

header.description: The path of its header in the same release.

shape.description: Its number of cells along each axis, in the order of its axes.

source.description: The source it was published by, by id.

unit.description: The unit of its axes, such as `megaparsec_over_h`.

HeaderField.description: A field of the header, at a fixed offset from the start of the tile.

bytes.description: `count` times the bytes of its type.

count.description: The elements of the type it holds, such as 3 for a corner's x, y and z.

offset.description: Its first byte, from the start of the tile.

oneOf.description: The value it must hold, if fixed; a decoder refuses any other.

HitPosition.description: A derived position: ICRS Cartesian about the barycentre, in its scale domain's unit.

IssueKey.description: What the owner asks to issue.

label.description: A name for the key, for the owner.

quotas.description: The quotas; the default quotas where absent.

tier.description: The tier; the standard tier where absent.

secret.description:
The secret to send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`: 256 random bits, hex encoded
after the `univ_` prefix. Only its SHA-256 is stored.

IssuedKey.description: A key just issued: its record and its secret, which no later response gives.

ItemContent.description:
What an item holds: a title, a summary, a geometry in a named frame, its time records, its
kind of value, its links and at least one source.

ItemHit.description: A layer item whose current shape meets the volume.

ItemRecord.description: An item: its current version and the list of all its versions, oldest first.

ItemSource.description: A source an item cites: its title, and at least one of an ADS bibcode, a DOI or a URL.

stored_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when the server stored it.

KeyChange.description: What the owner asks to change of a key.

KeyList.description: Every key the owner has issued.

KeyRecord.description: A key as the owner sees it, without its secret.

revoked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC; absent while the key stands.

usage.description: What the key has written, against its quotas.

KindOfValue.description: Whether a value was measured, estimated, inferred by analysis or reconstructed by a model.

LayerChange.description: What the owning key asks to change of a layer, each part kept where absent.

LayerList.description: Every layer a caller may read: the public ones, and the caller's key's private ones.

LayerPage.description: A layer and one page of its current items that are not retracted, by id.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, as `?cursor=`; absent on the last page.

LayerRecord.description: A layer as it is read and listed.

item_count.description: The layer's current items that are not retracted.

owner.description: The id of the key that owns it, which alone may change it.

sequence.description: The number of the layer's last change; 0 until its first.

LedgerChange.description: One change the id ledger records: what release `release` did to id `id`.

replaced_by.description: The ids that replaced it; none for a retirement.

Length.description: A length under the release cosmology.

Level.description:
A level of the octree: its nodes' edge and its quantization step, in the unit, and the
fraction of the points reaching it that each of its inner nodes keeps.

LineOfSight.description: The difference along the line of sight between two matched entries.

oneOf.description: |Δcz| between the heliocentric velocities, km/s.
|d1 − d2| over their mean, of the first distance of each entry.

distance.description: |d1 − d2| over their mean, of the first distance of each entry.

Link.description: A link from an item to one reference object, by its id, or one structure, by its id.

object.description: The id of an object some release published.

structure.description: The id of a structure some release published.

oneOf.description: An object id.
A common name, as the client wrote it.
A source's designation: the source's id and the identifier it gives.

MatchMethod.description: How two entries were found to agree along the line of sight.

MatchRecord.description: A positional match: the entry it was compared with and what the comparison found.

oneOf.description: The difference along the line of sight, when both entries carry the value compared.

separation_arcsec.description: The angular separation of the two ICRS positions, arcseconds.

with.description: The entry on the other side of the match.

MatchedBy.description:
What of a structure a volume was tested against, the first the release holds of: its placed
shape, its placed member list, its bounding box, its centre.

Measure.description:
Which distance a value is, as its source states it. Beyond the nearby universe the
cosmological distances differ, by a factor 1 + z between the luminosity and the comoving
distance of a flat universe; a later stage converts each to the comoving distance with the
release cosmology.

MeasuredQuantity.description: A measured quantity of an entry.

MeasuredValue.description:
A value as its source published it, beside its normalized form, with its kind of value.
Its schema is named `MeasuredValue`: an OpenAPI generator reads a type named `Value` as any
JSON value.

MeasurementKey.description: A measurement of the object, by its entry, quantity and place.

MeasurementRecord.description: One measurement of an entry, its native value beside its normalized one.

band.description:
A magnitude's band, as its source names the column, such as `Kcmag`; a colour index's
two bands, such as `B-V`.

derived_from.description:
The two magnitude columns a colour index was computed from, where its source publishes
the magnitudes and not the colour.

oneOf.description: What a distance is and how it was obtained.

entry.description: The entry it belongs to, by its number.

n.description: Its place among the entry's values of this quantity, from 0.

native.description: The value as its source published it, with its unit and uncertainty.

oneOf.description:
The value normalized; absent when it is the native value unchanged. For a redshift, the
z of the frame it was published in.
What a redshift is, and its CMB-frame value.

source.description: The source that published it: its entry's.

Member.description:
A member of a structure: an object, or a tracer with its own position and kind. An object
member carries the position it was resolved to at ingest, in the shape's frame and unit, so a
member list is bounded without looking its objects up.

Method.description: The indicator or technique behind a distance.

oneOf.description: Bailer-Jones et al. 2021, geometric prior.
Bailer-Jones et al. 2021, photogeometric prior.

A distance its source combined from several indicators, as its source lists them, such
as a Cosmicflows-4 group distance.

mixed.description:
A distance its source combined from several indicators, as its source lists them, such
as a Cosmicflows-4 group distance.

oneOf.description: An indicator named by its source that has no variant here.

other.description: An indicator named by its source that has no variant here.

MethodRank.description: The method ranks that break a tie in fractional distance uncertainty, best first.

NativeLength.description: A length as published, with the cosmology it was published for.

assumed.description:
The cosmology as the structure file states it, its words and citation; none for a length
in h⁻¹ Mpc whose file states none.

hubble_constant.description: The Hubble constant it assumed, km/s/Mpc: 100 for a length in h⁻¹ Mpc.

NodeEntry.description: One octree node and its tile.

address.description: `r`, then one octant digit, 0 to 7, per level below the root.

sampled_from.description:
The points that reached it, those of its cube that no node above holds: its tile holds
an even random subsample of them, or all of them for a leaf.

NotPlacedReason.description: Why an object has no three-dimensional position.

ObjectChoice.description: One object a lookup leads to.

href.description: The path of the object in the release the lookup read.

names.description: The spellings of the name the object carries, for a name lookup.

ObjectChoices.description: The objects a lookup leads to, answered with status 300 instead of choosing one of them.

history.description: For a replaced id, each change of the id ledger followed from it, in order.

objects.description: The objects, by id, each with the path that reads it in the same release.

replaced_in.description: For a replaced id, the release that replaced it.

ObjectHit.description: An object whose derived position lies in the volume.

ObjectId.description: An object's id in Univ releases: a positive integer that, once given, is never reused.

ObjectKind.description: What an object's sources list it as.

ObjectMerged.description: Where a merged id went, answered with status 301 and the object's path as `Location`.

history.description: Each change of the id ledger followed from it, in order.

merged_into.description: The one object of the release the lookup read that replaced it.

ObjectRecord.description: One object of a release, with everything every source published for it.

designations.description:
Every designation it carries, each a source and the identifier that source gives: its
entries' own and those their sources give beside them, such as a Hipparcos number.

entries.description: Every catalogue entry resolved to it, numbered from 0, the anchor first.

id.description: Its object id, stable across releases.

kind.description: What its sources list it as: one body, or a galaxy group.

links.description:
Each candidate match to another object, with its confidence: both stay separate
objects, and no measurement is merged across the link.

measurements.description: Every measurement of its entries, by entry, quantity and n.

oneOf.description: Why it is not placed; absent when it is.
Its derived three-dimensional position; absent when it is not placed.

The measurement that places it and the ranking that chose it; absent when it has no
distance, parallax or redshift to rank.

relations.description: Typed relations to other objects, such as a group's dominant galaxy.

release.description: The release it was read from.

oneOf.description: Its preferred sky position; absent when no entry has one.

OutlineRecord.description:
The test of a structure outlined from a volume grid, as `structure_details.outline` records
it: the grid, field, threshold and test its structure file states, the verdict and its
reason, the region's size and each check the test ran. An admitted outline is the
structure's placed shape; a refused one, or one not drawn, leaves it at its published
position.

cells.description: The cells of the region on the grid; 0 when none was drawn.

checks.description:
Each catalogue's comparison with the region: its coverage, galaxies held and expected,
and whether it passes.

dense.description: What the check of the dense places found, when the test states them.

field.description: The grid field the threshold applies to, such as `density`.

grid.description: The volume grid's source id, such as `cf4pp-density`.

reason.description: Why the outline was refused or not drawn; none when admitted.

test.description: The test as the structure file records it: its catalogues, rule, ratio and reasons.

threshold.description:
The threshold as the structure file records it: a cited value, or a choice of the
pipeline with the reason for it.

touches_edge.description: Whether the region reaches a face of the grid, which may cut it.

OutlineVerdict.description: Whether an outline's test admitted it.

retrieved.description: When it was retrieved, RFC 3339 UTC.

rows.description: The rows it held, where the format counts rows.

PointField.description:
A field of every point. The points' fields are stored as columns, in the order listed: the
column of a field starts at `header_bytes + column_offset × n`, `n` the tile's point count,
and point `k` (from 0) holds its value at `bytes × k` within the column.

bytes.description: The bytes it takes per point: `count` times the bytes of its type.

column_offset.description: The bytes of the columns before it, per point.

count.description: The elements of the type it holds per point, such as 3 for x, y and z.

PositionClass.description: The classes of sky position, best first, where the published uncertainties cannot decide.

PositionErrors.description: The errors in right ascension and declination, as published and in degrees.

PositionUncertainty.description:
The uncertainty of a position, each error as published beside its value in degrees.
Gaia and Hipparcos publish the error in right ascension as σ(α cos δ).

oneOf.description: The source published no error for the position, which is not an error of zero.

PreferredMeasurement.description: The measurement that places the object, and how the release's ranking rule chose it.

distance_mpc.description:
The distance it gives, Mpc: as published for a distance, the inverse parallax, or the
comoving distance of a redshift under the release cosmology.

measurement.description: The distance, redshift or parallax preferred.

rank.description: Its method rank, which breaks a tie in fractional uncertainty.

rule.description: The name of the release's ranking rule that chose it.

oneOf.description: The best of the measurements it was preferred over, where there was one.

uncertainty.description: The fractional distance uncertainty it was ranked by, with its parts.

Primitive.description: A solid of a simple form.

oneOf.description: Semi-axes along the columns of `orientation`, a rotation from the solid's axes to the frame.
Half-extents along the columns of `orientation`.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem details document, answered as application/problem+json, with any extension members after these.

ProblemType.description: The kind of problem, as a URN.

PublishItem.description:
An item to publish: its id, chosen by the client and unique within the layer, and its
content.

Quantity.description: A number with its unit and uncertainty.

QueryResult.description: One result of a volume query.

QuotaChange.description: Quotas to set, each kept as it is where absent.

RadialRange.description: The span of one radial measure over a source's entries.

basis.description: What the values are, such as "heliocentric redshift as published".

entries.description: How many entries hold the measure.

RateLimitTier.description: A key's rate-limit tier: how many requests it may make in 60 seconds.

RedshiftDetail.description: What a redshift measurement is, with its CMB-frame value.

cmb.description: Its CMB-frame redshift, dimensionless, with its uncertainty.

dipole.description: The dipole model that relates its heliocentric and CMB-frame values.

published_frame.description:
The frame it was published in: heliocentric, or the CMB frame, where the dipole model
only derives the heliocentric value back.

RedshiftFrame.description: The frame a redshift is published in.

Reference.description: A source's primary reference: its ADS bibcode or DOI, or why it has no single one.

note.description: Why there is no single primary reference, as for a compilation cited paper by paper.

Relation.description: How an item relates to the reference object or structure it links to.

RelationKind.description: How one object stands to another.

ReleaseCounts.description: How many of each thing a release holds.

ReleaseList.description: Every release ever published, newest first, and the one that `latest` points to.

latest.description: The number of the release that reads naming no release answer from.

releases.description: Every published release, pruned ones included, newest first.

cosmology.description: The cosmology every derived value of the release was computed under.

pruned_at.description: When it was pruned, if it was: its data is gone, and reads pinned to it are refused.

sources.description: The ids of the sources it was built from.

RescaledLength.description:
A length a structure file publishes under another cosmology, as published beside the length
rescaled to the release cosmology: an item of `structure_details.rescaled`.

factor.description: The rescaled length over the native one.

redshift.description: The redshift of the comoving ratio; none for the ratio of Hubble constants.

value.description: A JSON pointer (RFC 6901) to the length in the structure's record.

RescalingMethod.description: How a length was rescaled to the release cosmology.

Resolution.description:
How an entry came to belong to its object, tagged by `by`: a match keeps its own `method`
beside the tag, so the tag cannot be `method` too.

oneOf.description: The entry the object was resolved around: the first of its entries in the order read.

A published cross-identification: the entry shares the identifier `identifier` of
`scheme`, such as a Gaia `source_id` or a HIP number, with `via`.

allOf.description: A match by position, and by redshift or distance where the rule compares one.

oneOf.description: A match by position, and by redshift or distance where the rule compares one.

RetractItem.description: A retraction: the version it replaces, which must be the current one, and why.

ReviseItem.description:
A revision: the version it replaces, which must be the current one, and the content it
stores as the next version. A correction names the version it corrects and what was wrong.

corrects.description: The version a correction corrects; the one it replaces where absent.

what_was_wrong.description: What was wrong; required of a correction.

RevisionKind.description: What kind of revision a revision is.

Rotation.description: A rotation between frames, applied as `matrix · vector`.

Rotations.description: The rotations from the manifest's frame, each applied as `matrix · [x, y, z]`.

RunnerUp.description: The measurement a preferred one was preferred over.

Sampling.description: How the subsample was drawn, and the rules the octree was split by.

ScaleDomainList.description: The scale domains of a release.

ScaleDomainSummary.description: One scale domain: a set of points tiled into one octree.

manifest.description: The path of its tile manifest in the same release.

nodes.description: The nodes of its octree, one tile each.

radius.description: The radius it extends to from the Solar System barycentre, in its unit.

unit.description: The unit of its positions and of its radius.

Shape.description:
A geometry in a named frame, its Cartesian coordinates in one length unit. Checked when built
and when read.

SkyFootprint.description: A sky footprint as nested `HEALPix` cells of one order, in ICRS (Górski et al. 2005).

cells.description: The cells holding at least one entry, ascending.

SkyPositionRecord.description: The object's preferred sky position: ICRS degrees at its epoch.

class.description: The class of position that chose it where the uncertainties could not.

entry.description: The entry it is taken from, by its number.

uncertainty_mas.description:
Its published error, the root mean square of σ(α cos δ) and σ(δ), milliarcseconds;
absent when its source published none.

SourceDetail.description: One source in full: where its data came from and on what terms.

citation.description: Its citation, as its source definition gives it.

oneOf.description:
Where on the sky and how far its entries reach; absent from a release built before
coverage was recorded.

cuts.description: The cuts the fetch made and why, as the source definition states them.

entries.description: How many of its catalogue entries the release holds.

provider.description: The service it was fetched from, such as `vizier`.

query.description: The query the fetch ran: the access method, table, constraints and slices, verbatim.

oneOf.description: Its primary reference; absent from a release built before references were recorded.

release.description: The release it was read from.

terms.description: Its terms of use and the credit they require, verbatim.

SourceEntry.description: A source whose points, or whose sky positions, the tiles hold, at its index in the table.

credit.description: The credit the source requires, quoted from its terms.

release.description: The release the listing was answered from.

sources.description: Its sources, in the release's order.

SourceProvenance.description: The record of a source's acquisition and normalization.

oneOf.description:
How many catalogue entries were fetched, published and left out; absent for a source
that was not normalized from fetched rows, such as the researched structures.

fixes.description:
Each fix of a known defect of the source, with its reason and how many entries it
changed in this release.

left_out.description: How many entries were left out, by the reason each was left out.

payloads.description: Each payload fetched, with its SHA-256 and when it was retrieved.

SourceRole.description: What a source gives the points of a domain.

SourceSummary.description: One source as a listing gives it.

citation.description: Its citation, as its source definition gives it.

credit.description: The credit its terms of use require, as its source definition gives it.

entries.description: How many of its catalogue entries the release holds.

scale_domain.description: The scale domain its points are tiled in: `stars`, `nearby_galaxies` or `cosmic_web`.

SpectralTypeRecord.description: A spectral type as its source publishes it.

kind_of_value.description:
Measured where the source classified the star's spectrum, estimated where it fitted a
model to it.

Step.description: A step of a chain: the transformation and its citation.

oneOf.description: The placed geometry's axis-aligned bounds, in the centre's frame and unit.
How the placed numbers were derived from the published ones.

members.description:
Its members placed whole: objects of the release, or tracers with their own positions
and kinds.

oneOf.description:
For a structure outlined from a volume grid: the grid, the threshold, the test and its
verdict.

record.description:
The structure as its researched file records it, verbatim: each published number with
its kind of value, its citation (paper and table, figure or sentence), and the geometry
in the frames the papers used.

rescaled.description:
Each size published under another cosmology, as published and rescaled to the release
cosmology.

oneOf.description:
The placed geometry, one of univ-model's geometry kinds, in a named frame: an admitted
outline keeps its grid's frame; every other structure is in ICRS.

status.description: `observed`, `reconstructed` or `statistical_claim`: how the structure is known.

StructureHit.description: A structure that meets the volume, and what of it was tested.

StructurePage.description: A page of a release's structures, by id.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, while structures remain.

release.description: The release the page was read from; every page of one listing reads the same release.

structures.description: The structures of this page, ordered by id.

StructureSummary.description: A structure as a listing gives it.

oneOf.description: The centre of its geometry; absent when it cannot be placed.

Terms.description: A source's terms of use, as its definition quotes them.

redistribution.description: Whether the terms allow the source to be published, and on what condition.

review.description: How that reading of the terms was reviewed.

TileCovering.description: The tile nodes of a scale domain that cover the volume, at the level chosen for it.

level.description:
The deepest level, no deeper than asked, at which at most [`MAX_TILE_NODES`] nodes
meet the volume.

TileFormat.description:
How to decode a release's tiles (decode-the-tile-format): the byte layout of each tile
encoding its scale domains use, and the schema of a tile manifest.

encodings.description: The byte layout of each encoding version the release's tiles use, by version.

manifest_schema.description: The JSON Schema of a tile manifest, as the OpenAPI document gives it.

TileManifest.description: A tile manifest, in the order its JSON gives its fields.

cosmology.description: The release cosmology the positions were derived under.

levels.description:
Each level present, root first, with its node edge, quantization step and sampling
fraction.

points.description: The points of every tile together.

radius.description: The largest distance of a point from the barycentre, in the unit.

TileRequest.description: The tile nodes wanted with the first page.

max_level.description: The deepest octree level to give; the deepest a manifest holds when absent.

TimeBound.description: A bound of an interval of time, in the form of a time record's time.

TimeFilter.description:
Layer items with a time record of `kind` whose uncertainty interval meets `from` to `to`,
compared on TT.

TimeRecord.description: A time attached to an item, with its kind, its timescale and its uncertainty.

oneOf.description: No uncertainty was reported: not the same as none at all.
±`sigma`, one standard deviation.
The time lies between `minus` before it and `plus` after it.

TimeUnit.description: The unit of an uncertainty: seconds, days, or Julian years of 365.25 days.

Timescale.description: The timescale a time is given in.

oneOf.description: The distance as its source published it, and which distance that is.

A distance modulus to a luminosity distance, `d = 10^(μ/5 + 1)` pc, its error carried
to an asymmetric interval.

A length published for the Hubble constant of `assumed`, rescaled to the release's by
`factor = H0(assumed) / H0(release)`, as a length inferred from a velocity scales as
1 / H0.

A length rescaled by the ratio of the comoving distances of `redshift` in the release
cosmology and in the flat ΛCDM of `assumed`, which keeps a size in proportion to the
distance of its structure at any redshift.

A luminosity distance to a comoving one, `D_C = D_L / (1 + z)`, with the CMB-frame
redshift of the same entry, spectroscopic or photometric.
The comoving distance of a CMB-frame redshift in the release cosmology.

The comoving distance in the release cosmology of a redshift its source published in the
CMB frame, used as published, with no dipole step.
A parallax as its source published it.
A parallax zero point subtracted from a parallax: `ϖ − Z`, in mas.

A parallax inverted to a distance, `d = 1 / ϖ`, its interval exactly
`[1 / (ϖ + σ), 1 / (ϖ − σ)]`; an inferred distance.
A distance kept as published, with the reason; it is not a comoving distance.

A Euclidean distance taken as it is: the cosmological distances differ from it by about
`H0 d / c`, the fraction given.
A direction moved from its published frame to the ICRS.
A direction whose equinox is not stated, placed as J2000 with this systematic error.
Spherical to Cartesian in the ICRS, with the Solar System barycentre as origin.
The ICRS Cartesian position rotated into another frame.

Uncertainty.description: The uncertainty of a value, in the form its source published it.

oneOf.description: The source published no uncertainty: not the same as an uncertainty of zero.
A symmetric error, ±`sigma`.
An asymmetric one-sigma error: the value is `value - minus` to `value + plus`.

A stated interval with no probability: the source says the value lies between
`value - minus` and `value + plus`, its lower and upper bounds, such as the redshift slice
a structure was found in. It is not a one-sigma error, and nothing reads it as one.
The value is an upper limit.
The value is a lower limit.
The value lies in a credible region of this probability, described by its geometry.

A one-dimensional credible region: the value's posterior holds `probability` between
`value - minus` and `value + plus`, such as the 16th to 84th percentiles of Bailer-Jones et
al. 2021 (probability 0.68). The bounds are kept as offsets, as they scale with the value.

Unit.description: A unit that a source publishes a value in, or that a value is normalized to.

Usage.description: What a key has written, against its quotas.

largest_layer_items.description: The number of items its largest layer holds, retracted ones included.

VersionBody.description: What a version holds beyond its number, time and kind, as stored.

content.description: The item's content; absent from a retraction.

reason.description: Why a retraction withdrew the item.

what_was_wrong.description: What was wrong with the version a correction corrects.

VersionKind.description: What kind of version an item's version is.

VersionSummary.description: A version as an item's list of versions gives it.

Visibility.description: Who may read a layer: anyone, or only its owning key.

frame.description: `icrs`, `galactic` or `supergalactic`; the axes are Cartesian about the barycentre.

unit.description: A unit of length, such as `parsec` or `megaparsec`.

Volume.description: A volume as a query gives it.

VolumeForm.description: The form of a volume, by its member `form`.

oneOf.description: Axis-aligned in the volume's frame.
Apex at the barycentre; `lon`, `lat` and `opening_angle` in degrees.

VolumePage.description: A page of a volume query's results.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, while results remain.

results.description: Objects by id, then structures by id, then layer items by layer and item.

served.description: The results given so far, this page's included.

tiles.description:
For each scale domain the filters leave, the tile nodes that cover the volume; on the
first page alone.

truncated.description: Whether more than [`MAX_RESULTS`] results matched and only the first were given.

VolumeQuery.description:
A query of the objects, structures and layer items in a volume. Its later pages send the
same query with the cursor the page before gave.

oneOf.description: Layer items whose time records of a kind meet an interval.

api_key.description: An API key the owner issued.

owner.description: The owner secret the Worker was given.

info.description: Real, normalized astronomical and cosmological data, and the layers clients author on top of it.

Lists every layer the caller may read and that is not retired: each public layer, and the
caller's key's private ones.

# Errors

A problem answer: no key (401), the body not a layer to create (400), the key's quota of
layers reached (403), or the database failing.

Creates a layer owned by the caller's key: private unless asked public, its change
sequence at 0. The insert itself holds the key to its quota of layers.

parameters.name: id

404.description: No such layer

Retires a layer: it and its items are served no more, and it leaves its key's quota of
layers. The retirement is the layer's last change.

their links resolved against the release read.
